result.title: Mixing Regularization for Average-Reward $Q$-Learning and $Q$-Planning
result.comment: 10 pages main body, 56 pages references and appendix, 8 figures. Under review
result.summary: The average-reward setting for reinforcement learning is challenging because its Bellman operator is known to contract in span only when the underlying Markov chain is mixing. Whereas existing work typically assumes a contraction property, e.g., through environment mixing, we consider the setting where we are given a reward-agnostic $m$-step mixing policy, and we control the contraction and exploration properties of the learned policy by regularizing toward the mixing policy. We provide finite-time analysis of $Q$-learning algorithms that can be instantiated with multiple choices of regularization, with guarantees measured with respect to the regularized fixed point. Our framework exposes novel regularizer-dependent objects that control contraction, exploration, and operator bias. In the one-step setting, our rates match the best known rates for $Q$-iteration and synchronous $Q$-learning, and for $m$-step mixing we derive new rates. We also study $Q$-planning variants, and show that planning acts as time-localized learning, where the planning horizon $H$ trades off the bias from the boundary value against the sample complexity. Finally, we present numerical studies validating the analysis: (i) knowledge of a strong mixing policy improves convergence and exploration, and its advantage increases with bottleneck severity and, (ii) our theory predicts the convergence and bias rankings of regularizers from the $α$-divergence family.

AI.brief_summary: 在平均奖励强化学习设定下，研究向 m-step mixing policy 正则化的 Q-learning 与 Q-planning，给出有限时间收敛分析，并刻画正则项对收缩性、探索与算子偏差的影响。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「planning 即时域局部化的学习、规划视界 H 在边界值偏差与样本复杂度间权衡」的结论，可能为 LVR 中 latent 迭代步数（计算预算）与推理偏差的取舍、以及何时停止推理，提供概念类比，可供核查。
